primary.title: BSE, SAIL to HFCL: Midcap, smallcap stocks jump up to 112% YTD despite US-Iran war; will their outperformance continue?
primary.summary: Small and mid-cap stocks have notably outperformed large caps in 2026. The Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 posted positive returns due to strong earnings growth and favourable business outlooks, while large caps faced declines in the same period.
